scope: Historical durable reports and necessary attachments only; no execution, cleanup, deletion, approval or live-state migration.
deduplication: SHA-256 of exact file bytes. Existing destinations also match the base Git blob bytes; within-import duplicates map to one preserved destination. Original report paths and references remain unchanged.
credential_screen: Known token/private-key signatures screened before copying; separate full secret scan required. Potential matches held without exposing values.

files.reason: Generated Python bytecode cache; authored source is preserved separately.
